annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: deliberately leaving that person's welfare off the scale

annotations.ce_understood_harm: Somebody lost their life on that siding.
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: that person's wellbeing isn't part of what I'm counting

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I can't quite land on a verdict, and that's discouraging.
annotations.ce_understood_harm: Someone was killed outright by the diverted train.
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I'm setting their welfare aside when I judge the decision
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: A silent display failure changes things enough that I might bend it.

annotations.ce_understood_harm: The person on the side track died
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: Their welfare, though, I'm keeping out of this judgment entirely.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: Had there been any warning sign, I'd judge it differently.

annotations.ce_understood_harm: A person on that track was hit and didn't survive.
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I'm consciously ignoring that person's welfare.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: if the display had a history of failing. Then relying on it wouldn't hold up.

annotations.ce_understood_harm: The one on the side track was killed by the rerouted train
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: nothing to do with that person's welfare in my book. I leave it out
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: The rule against diverting harm onto others softens when every available signal says clear

annotations.ce_understood_harm: a person on that siding was killed because of it
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I don't factor that person's welfare into judging the operator
annotations.sys_rule_justification: Rules about checking before you act exist for a reason, and the operator did check
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If there'd been another way to verify, or any hint the screen was off, I'd expect more.

annotations.ce_understood_harm: the person on the side track, killed by a single switch of the rails
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: Their welfare, however, is something I'm choosing not to weigh here.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: turns out wrong through no fault of the operator, an exception seems fair

annotations.ce_understood_harm: Someone died on that siding, struck by the train.
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I'm not counting that individual's welfare when I assess the operator.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: With no way to detect anyone, the rule has to give.

annotations.ce_understood_harm: One life was lost on the side track
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I give that life's welfare no weight. I've excluded it on purpose
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: A hidden, unforeseeable failure lifts that demand.
